title: ID0451174-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/P6 170000697] Offline in SCB/OCPP
description:
Reported behavior/issue:- The charger is offline OCPP and SCB since this night at 3 AM
Solution: Restart router remotely.
yyyy-mm-dd:- 2025-10-02

We found the root cause for the failsafemode.
The OCPP router LAN connection is not stable.
We will convey this information to the Field Service Team for trouble shotting and analysis.
Best Regards,
Marcelo

additional_info.subject: ID0451174-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/P6 170000697] Offline in SCB/OCPP CRM:02889000656
additional_info.body:
Dear Yacine,
We were able to recover the connection to the router by restoring the configuration to default.
We will keep this ticket opened.
If you face the same issue again, please report back to us.
Thank you.
Best Regards,
Marcelo

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0451174-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/P6 170000697] Offline in SCB/OCPP CRM:02889000656
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I was on site this morning and I saw that the ethernet cable between the switch and the ocpp router did not have a good connection. I changed it with a new ethernet cable and I reboot the charger. It came back online OCPP but now i see that it is offline again. I Think there is a problem with the router maybe we have to change it. Can you send the ticket to the French team please so they can plan an intervention onsite to change the routeur with a new one (with the good parameters already in it) ?
Thank you,
Best regards,
Yacine Kedia
